description: Store resume text in the vault and get a resumeId (rs_1.<uuid>) to reuse on generate. Prefer resumeId on later generate over re-pasting the full resume. Pass resume text here. For PDF/DOCX/DOC/TXT/MD files, use HTTP POST /api/resumes multipart field "file" (max ~8MB) — this MCP tool is text-only. Stored text is used as-is (honesty lock; never invent employers). TTL ~30 days. Honesty lock: we only rearrange what is already true. Never invent employers, dates, skills, or metrics.
name: store_resume
title: Store resume text once
